contracts: (A discovered restore recovery assertion proves current capabilities are newly allocated and distinct.) AND (A discovered restore recovery assertion proves the old port reference cannot authorize current restored runtime access.) AND (All original failure entries remain readable and precede newly appended retry entries.) AND (Discovered results contain non-skipped cancellation and failure scenarios.) AND (Durable Attempt leaves Staging and records a bounded subsequent stage or outcome before timeout.) AND (Every affected staging path is attributable to the Attempt and no foreign staging changes.) AND (Post-cleanup readback verifies active Attempt inputs remain available and unchanged.) AND (RestoreBoundaryTests discovers and passes the corrupt-size preservation case with workspace evidence.) AND (RestoreBoundaryTests discovers and passes the exhausted-quota denial case with typed denial and no publication evidence.) AND (RestoreBoundaryTests discovers and passes the unsafe-path denial case with typed denial and no publication evidence.) AND (RestoreBoundaryTests discovers and passes the unsupported-version denial case with typed denial and no publication evidence.) AND (Retry records reference one Attempt/publication, preserve prior history, and do not remain indefinitely Staging.) AND (Selector executes and observes stale Restore rejection without publication.) AND (The coordinator trace has no execution event after the declared atomic boundary and contains an audited disablement outcome.) AND (The exact RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered and passes with a byte-for-byte unchanged previous workspace after a wrong-tenant denial; the full PhaseA.Platform.Tests suite passes.) AND (The exact RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered and passes with a byte-for-byte unchanged previous workspace after corrupt-hash denial; the full PhaseA.Platform.Tests suite passes.) AND (The exact RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered and passes with a byte-for-byte unchanged previous workspace after quota denial; the full PhaseA.Platform.Tests suite passes.) AND (The exact RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered and passes with a typed corrupt-hash denial and no ready publication; the full PhaseA.Platform.Tests suite passes.) AND (The exact corrupt-size selector is discovered, runs with a nonzero count, and verifies typed denial before ready publication.) AND (The exact selector executes payload and tenant variants and proves denial with no operation reuse.) AND (The exact selector is discovered and executes with nonzero count, proving rejection and unchanged workspace digest.) AND (The exact unsupported-schema preservation selector is discovered, runs with a nonzero count, and confirms unchanged content and readiness.) AND (The exact unsupported-schema selector is discovered, runs with a nonzero count, and verifies typed denial before ready publication.) AND (The exact unsupported-version preservation selector is discovered, runs with a nonzero count, and confirms unchanged content and readiness.) AND (The report validator confirms fixture bounds, nonempty stage samples, approval-time exclusion, reproducible P95, and explicit 30-minute comparison.) AND (The targeted RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered and passes with typed denial and no publication; whole-suite validation remains required.) AND (The targeted RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered and passes with typed denial and unchanged ready Workspace; whole-suite validation remains required.) AND (The targeted RestoreBoundaryTests selector is discovered and passes, proving recomputation and no publication; the full restore recovery suite must also pass.) AND (The timer-specific selector is discovered with a nonzero count and observes no Restore start; then the full test suite is run.) AND (目标测试发现并执行，且证明 final metadata commit 后重启可由 durable Attempt/staging 完成 reconciliation。) AND (目标测试发现并执行，验证 copy 中断后重启 reconciliation 仅依赖 durable Attempt/staging。) AND (目标测试被发现并执行，且验证 switch 中断后重启 reconciliation 使用 durable Attempt/staging 完成 outcome。) AND (目标测试被发现并执行，验证 intent 后重启 reconciliation 基于 durable Attempt/staging 完成。)
selector_intents: Execute the stale Restore holder publication selector; expected runtime observation is rejection at the publication boundary.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests exercises the production atomic-operation coordinator and detects execution beyond the declared boundary after Account disablement.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests observes retry/recovery and asserts a bounded transition out of Staging.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests repeats an equivalent Restore request and checks one durable Attempt/publication with appended history.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests verifies corrupt-size rejection preserves the prior workspace.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests verifies exhausted-quota restore emits typed denial before ready publication.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests verifies that retry processing preserves every prior failure-history entry.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests verifies unsafe-path restore emits typed denial before ready publication.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests verifies unsupported-version restore emits typed denial before ready publication.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests.MismatchedRestoreRequest_IsDeniedAndNotReused observes acceptance or operation-ID reuse for mismatched payload or tenant.
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests.Restart_ReconcilesEveryRestoreStage_AfterFinalMetadataCommit：终止 final metadata commit 后的独立 restore 进程并重启，验证 reconciliation 从 durable Attempt/staging 得出 outcome。
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests.Restart_ReconcilesEveryRestoreStage_AfterIntent：终止 intent 持久化后的独立 restore 进程并重启，验证 reconciliation 使用 durable Attempt/staging。
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests.Restart_ReconcilesEveryRestoreStage_DuringCopy：终止 copy 阶段的独立 restore 进程并重启，验证 reconciliation 从 durable Attempt/staging 得出 outcome。
PhaseB.Repair.RestoreBoundaryTests.Restart_ReconcilesEveryRestoreStage_DuringSwitch：在 switch 阶段终止独立 restore 进程后重启，验证 reconciliation 使用 durable Attempt/staging 而非 chat 或旧进程。
